title: Agent profile registry
description: Each agent is declared up front by what it is good at, so a caller knows how to call it and how to sequence it (T-t6-05). model_class is a routing class, never a vendor (F-a4-01).

good_at.description: Specific enough to sequence on. 'good at code' is not an entry; 'turns a stack trace into a failing-test command' is.

not_for.description: The call that should go to a different profile.

model_class.description: Routing class by prefix: f- free local GPU, i- interactive metered, b- asynchronous batch, cli- coding CLI as a model (F-a4-02..F-a4-05). A bare prefix pins the class and leaves the member to the gateway.

fields.description: field name to declared type: string, string[], integer, boolean, object
